design.title: Brand
design.description: How your brand appears in simulated shopping answers.
design.sample: {count, plural, one {# sampled answer} other {# sampled answers}} · {engines}
design.scope: The model receives your brand as audit context. This is a simulation, not a blind recall test or a record of live customer conversations.

empty.title: Find your brand’s blind spots.
empty.description: See whether your brand comes up in shopping questions, how it is described, and where clearer information could help.
empty.note: Uses your store and catalog to prepare 20 questions for ChatGPT. You can keep working while the analysis runs.
empty.visualTitle: From a shopper’s question to your next step

questions.title: Ask about your category
questions.description: Questions with and without your brand name.

answers.title: Inspect the answers
answers.description: Brand mentions, alternatives and answer summaries.

actions.title: See what to improve
actions.description: Suggestions grounded in the sampled answers.

design.noAnswers: This report has no saved answers. Run a new analysis to build the evidence.
design.journeyDescription: Suggestions from this analysis. Review the evidence before changing your site.
design.noSuggestions: No changes suggested for this stage.
design.sourcesNote: These are domains or source types named by the model, not verified citations from a live search.
design.accessDescription: A snapshot of public discovery files. These checks do not measure search indexing, rankings or checkout readiness.

robots.fail: The scan found crawler restrictions in robots.txt.
robots.note: robots.txt controls access by crawler. Search, user-initiated requests and model training can use different crawlers.

llms.warn: No reachable llms.txt file was recorded.
llms.note: This optional content guide does not guarantee that an AI service reads, indexes or recommends your brand.

engines.pass: No root-level blocks were detected for the checked crawlers.
engines.warn: Access could not be confirmed in this scan.
engines.fail: Some checked crawlers have root-level restrictions.
engines.note: Path-specific rules, other crawlers and indexing are outside this check.

failed.title: The analysis couldn’t finish
failed.description: Your last completed report is still available below. Try again when you’re ready.
failed.emptyDescription: No report was saved. Try again when you’re ready.

design.error: We couldn’t start the analysis. Please try again.

running.title: Getting to know your brand
running.description: ChatGPT is working through your shopping questions. Results will appear here when ready.
running.previous: You’re viewing the previous report while the new analysis runs.
running.steps: Prepare questions · Review answers · Build recommendations

unavailable.title: Brand data is temporarily unavailable
unavailable.description: We couldn’t load your saved analysis. Refresh this section to try again.

design.noFindings: No patterns were saved in this report.

started.description: You can keep working. Results will appear here when the analysis finishes.
